description: A utility class for managing financial account operations within the OfBiz framework, including account code generation, balance calculations, and validation functions.

classes.name: FinAccountHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for financial account management operations such as code generation, balance calculations, and validation.

methods.name: getDecimals
methods.description: Returns the configured number of decimal places for financial calculations.

methods.name: getRounding
methods.description: Returns the configured RoundingMode for financial calculations.

methods.name: getZero
methods.description: Returns a BigDecimal representing zero with the configured scale and rounding.

methods.name: getGiftCertFinAccountTypeId
methods.description: Returns the account type ID for gift certificate accounts.

methods.name: addFirstEntryAmount
methods.description: Adds the amount from the first transaction in a list to an initial value, considering scale and rounding.

methods.name: getNewFinAccountCode
methods.description: Generates a unique random account code consisting of uppercase letters and digits.

methods.name: getFinAccountFromCode
methods.description: Retrieves a FinAccount entity based on a cleaned-up version of the provided account code.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Calculates the balance of a financial account by summing deposit and withdrawal transactions up to a specified date.

methods.name: getAvailableBalance
methods.description: Computes the available balance by subtracting authorized but unexpired amounts from the total balance.

methods.name: validateFinAccount
methods.description: Placeholder for validation logic for a FinAccount entity.

methods.name: validatePin
methods.description: Validates a PIN number against the stored finAccountCode for a financial account.

methods.name: checkFinAccountNumber
methods.description: Validates the format of an account number using the Luhn algorithm.
